Computational analysis via DharmaNexus identifies 39 shared text segments between the *Taraṇīyattheraapadāna* and 16 other Pali texts, with no cross-language parallels meeting the evaluation threshold [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial internal reuse occurs with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo bhāgo), involving 8 matches (notably segments §3.1–3.4 aligning with §1283–1284) [DharmaNexus]. The text also exhibits substantial stock verse reuse with numerous other Therāpadāna poems, including the *Pañcaṅguliyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 172), two poems entitled *Punnāgapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 161 and Tha-Ap 335), the *Pāpanivāriyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 222), and the homonymous *Taraṇiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 272) [DharmaNexus].
